# Contributing

Run `python3 -m unittest discover -s tests` before pushing. CI runs the same
command on every pull request.

If a change alters something a design note describes, update the note in the
same pull request. Reviewers ask for this.

Keep schema changes (`src/db/`) and adapter changes (`src/api/`) in separate
commits when practical.
